newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan shipping stocks rise on Taiwan-China talks.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan shipping stocks rise on Taiwan-China talks.

text.p: Taiwan shipping shares surged at mid-session on Wednesday, reflecting investor hopes that a Hong Kong meeting of Taiwan and China shipping leaders would help progress toward ending a ban on direct links, brokers said.
With 85 minutes left, Yang Ming Marine was up T$1.0 to T$38.50, Evergreen Marine T$1.50 to T$55.50 and First Steamship T$1 to T$22.20.

Transport officials and shipping executives from Taiwan and China were scheduled to meet on Wednesday in Hong Kong in their private capacities to discuss technical aspects of Taiwan's offshore transshipment centre.
